QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Don't Even Ask
QuestInfo.0: You delivered the letter to Vaughn Tremier, the second most powerful man in Commerci. He was not quite what you were expecting, and he has quite a bit to say.
QuestInfo.1: Vaughn Tremier claimed that Gilberto's karma was finally catching up to him, and scoffed at his letter. It wasn't pretty, but Gilberto will need to know.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Vaughn Tremier's message to Gilberto, asking him to take full responsibility for the Heaven Empire's demands. Gilberto did not take it well.

0.0: Psh. Gilberto gets his stockings in a bunch when the Heaven Empire comes calling. I'm not the fool who put this whole nation on the line.
0.1: Tell that pompous fool he's talking nonsense. He made his mess. He can clean it up.

yes.0: My union needs my attention, not some muddy deal with that backstabbing lout.

no.0: Didn't you say you were Gilberto's messenger?

npc.0: Leave me alone, you little parasite.
